title: Fallujah & Dur-Kurigalzu
full_text:
8 AM After breakfast we will go to the town of Fallujah passing by the famous prison of Abu Ghraib.
The traditional Kebab of Fallujah for lunch.
Back to Baghdad, to visit The Ziggurat of Dur-Kurigalzu and Enlil temples which are dedicated to Sumerian gods. The Ziggurat was unusually well preserved, standing to a height of about fifty-two metres.
internal_notes: SAFA without Samarra, so a trip that already reaches Samarra by SAMO can still take the west. Sold as this day in four offers: offer_routes.json days at lines 1939, 2246, 2375 and 2685. SAFA and BGFA are an alternative pair (ws-03 phase seven, WP36.1).
